correctness.rationale: The externally proved three-branch James profile in Mizuguchi (2020) Theorem4.1 was checked against the full source. Differentiation independently gives F1’=(2b²−1)/(2b²)<0 up to r, F2’=−(b²+4b−3)/(b²−b+1)² with exactly one interior maximum on [r,2/3], F3’=−2b(b−1)/(b²+2b−1)²>0 on [2/3,1). Values at junctions are F1(r)=F2(r)=(3sqrt5−1)/4 and F2(2/3)=F3(2/3)=10/7, latter strictly larger. At k=(1−r)/r=r the six consecutive decagon vertices satisfy v_(j+1)=(1/r)v_j−v_(j−1), with 1/r=2cos(pi/5); the central opposites complete an invertible image of a regular decagon. SymPy independently reproduced all rational derivative formulas and the exact endpoint comparison; the proof depends on the cited full published source profile, not a finite parameter scan.
